name: evalglass-core
description: An AI quality-control tool for agentic apps. Tell your agent to evaluate your app: EvalGlass scans your repo for candidate LLM call sites, vendors a stdlib-only runtime into your repo, scaffolds starter checks over host-owned gold/rubrics/thresholds, and wires CI on a single Verdict Engine that blocks only after you approve a gate — reporting only what the evidence honestly supports. You decide what to measure; EvalGlass derives no metrics on its own.

interface.shortDescription: Honest, local-first AI quality control for agentic apps — no false green.
interface.longDescription: EvalGlass is an AI quality-control tool for agentic apps. Ask your agent to evaluate your app: it discovers candidate LLM call sites, vendors a stdlib-only runtime into your repo, scaffolds host-owned gold/rubrics/thresholds with safe informational defaults, and wires CI on a single Verdict Engine. A green or non-failing run never implies more evidence, authority, calibration, comparability, or safety than the run earned — the host validates and the runtime decides; the plugin only types commands and reads back typed artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate my agentic app with EvalGlass.
Set up EvalGlass evaluation for this repo and run the quickstart.
